name: Casse Artisanal
description: Fondateur des Ferrailleurs bâtissant des colonies entières à partir de déchets créant des avant-postes viables dans les environnements les plus hostiles.

subject.archetype: Improvised Combat Specialist - Founder of the Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture

loadout.armor_outfit: Massively patched obsolete mining spacesuit with asymmetrical plates welded from salvaged cargo container metal, oxidized steel panels from spacecraft hulls, entire sections reinforced with layered duct tape and exposed welding seams, thick layered fabric underneath saturated with engine grease and burn marks, improvised chest plate assembled from bent traffic signs and car body panels with visible rivets and crude welds, shoulder guards made from repurposed industrial pipe fittings, forearm guards wrapped in copper wire coils for artisanal EMP shielding, heavy tool harness covered in dangling carabiners, utility pouches, and coiled cables, all held together with massive quantities of silver and gray duct tape, scratched opaque visor from a space welding helmet with visible cracks sealed with tape
loadout.arsenal: Gigantic improvised kinetic hammer constructed from a repurposed mining jackhammer head welded to a vehicle suspension spring shaft, crude copper coil wrapped around the striking chamber for electromagnetic amplification, crude battery packs duct-taped directly to the weapon body with exposed wiring creating sparks, secondary weapon a harpoon gun cobbled together from engine parts and cargo crane mechanisms

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist fully committed to the fight in a dying warrior's last devastating act, violently slamming both hands downward into the asteroid floor with explosive force, sending a concentrated shockwave rippling through all adjacent positions in the zero-gravity environment, every muscle strained and body contorted in the moment of ultimate sacrifice, surrounded by floating debris and sparks, weapons clenched in desperate final strike
attitude.emotion: Absolute determination mixed with the agony of a warrior's final moments, cold fury channeled into devastating last action, visceral intensity captured in frozen moment of explosive commitment

palette_names.name: Oxidized Steel Gray
palette_names.role: Primary dominant color for armor and debris

palette_names.name: Rust Orange
palette_names.role: Secondary dominant representing corrosion and heat

palette_names.name: Engine Grease Black
palette_names.role: Deep shadows and stained clothing areas

palette_names.name: Molten Metal Orange-Red
palette_names.role: Cascading liquid metal and burning rivers in background

palette_names.name: Hot Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: Energy accent from weapons and exposed copper coils

palette_names.name: Bright Spark Yellow-White
palette_names.role: Grinding sparks and impact effects filling the air

palette_names.name: Chipped Construction Yellow
palette_names.role: Accent details on improvised armor plates

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic multi-source lighting with orange-red glow from molten metal rivers illuminating from below, harsh blue-white sparks creating erratic highlights, plasma blue glow emanating from weapon coils, ambient cold blue fill light from distant stars through asteroid cracks, volumetric dust particles catching all light sources
color_and_light.mood: Catastrophic desperation, violent beauty, desperate last stand atmosphere

camera.angle: Low angle Dutch tilt to emphasize the explosive downward slam and add visual instability matching the chaos, slightly tilted frame to enhance sense of motion and danger

scenography.setting: Hollowed asteroid interior converted into active scrapyard warfare zone, massive collapsed spacecraft structures creating skeletal metal frameworks, cargo container fragments embedded in asteroid walls, improvised barricades made from stacked debris and welded metal plates buckling under assault, ruptured fuel tanks spewing cascading molten metal forming burning rivers across the floor, floating debris suspended in low-gravity environment after breaking free from structures, grinding sparks showering the scene from clashing improvised weapons
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Heavy particulate dust floating in zero-gravity, orange-red molten metal flowing in rivers, thousands of bright white-yellow sparks raining from weapon impacts, blue plasma energy crackling from exposed weapon coils, smoke and vapor from burning structures, impact shockwave distortion ripples visible in air, debris slowly tumbling in background after explosions, emergency red warning lights flickering in destroyed machinery
